Strategy rules

Strategy: Moving-Average & RSI Showcase

Enter long when the fast SMA crosses above the slow EMA in an uptrend

Direction: LONG

GIVEN no open position
WHEN sma_crosses_above_ema(fast, slow) AND price_above_sma(fast) AND vol is above 1
THEN enter LONG

Stop: entry_price * (1 - stop_loss_pct / 100)

Enter long when price reclaims the fast SMA above the daily pivot

Direction: LONG

GIVEN no open position
WHEN price_crosses_above_sma(fast) AND price_above_pivot(P)
THEN enter LONG

Stop: entry_price * (1 - stop_loss_pct / 100)

Exit long when the fast SMA crosses below the slow EMA

Direction: LONG

GIVEN an open long position
WHEN sma_crosses_below_ema(fast, slow)
THEN close the position

Exit long when price breaks below the fast SMA

Direction: LONG

GIVEN an open long position
WHEN price_crosses_below_sma(fast)
THEN close the position

Enter short when price loses the slow EMA below the pivot

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN no open position
WHEN price_crosses_below_ema(slow) AND price_below_pivot(P)
THEN enter SHORT

Stop: entry_price * (1 + stop_loss_pct / 100)

Enter short on an RSI 50 breakdown below both averages

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN no open position
WHEN RSI crosses the 50 mid-line (rsi_crosses_50) AND price_below_sma(slow) AND price_below_ema(slow)
THEN enter SHORT

Stop: entry_price * (1 + stop_loss_pct / 100)

Exit short when price reclaims the slow EMA

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN an open short position
WHEN price_crosses_above_ema(slow)
THEN close the position

Exit short when price holds above the fast EMA

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN an open short position
WHEN price_above_ema(fast)
THEN close the position
